messages:
jamie: Quick check — planning a staggered rollout for v0.15 next Wed (target day). Goal: runtime -> api -> console -> sdk. Any blockers? Also need changelog entries across repos.

maria: timeline sounds good from release ops POV. runtime infra fine. @kevin can you confirm runtime PR number and canary window?

kevin: runtime PR is #4123, merged to release/runtime-0.15 branch. Canary planned for 2h. No breaking public API changes in runtime.

ryan: API side: PR #2109 contains the bump; swagger regen included. ETA to cut RC: tomorrow afternoon. We do have a minor query param surface tweak (non-breaking).

ellie: console: we'll wait for API tag. Console PR #78 updates pin to `redwood-api@0.15.0`. I can drive console release once API tag is published.

maria: SDK: two packages to publish. Need to update examples and confirm lockfile. I can bundle after console release. Double-checking yarn v4 lock behaviour.

jamie: agree on order. Suggest schedule: 09:00 runtime canary -> 10:30 promote runtime -> 11:00 API canary -> 12:00 promote API -> 13:00 console rollout -> 14:00 SDK publish. Thoughts? @kevin @ryan

kevin: timings ok. We'll watch token-latency dashboards. Please add an alert for p95 > 200ms. Runtime uses a new kernel path — ensure rollout flag is off by default in prod config.

ryan: will do. I'll update the release playbook with health-check steps. Add this snippet to the playbook for API smoke check:

```
# simple health check
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .status
```

deploy-bot: Deploy check: runtime canary job queued for release/runtime-0.15. Preflight: unit tests passed, integration smoke failed on credentials mock. See CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/insights/4123

kevin: looking into CI failure — ephemeral credentials mock changed. Quick fix ready; PR #4130 opened to pin the test harness.

ellie: changelog time: I'll assemble entries. Can everyone paste a one-line bullet for their repo so I can squash into CHANGELOG.md?

jamie: runtime: "runtime: upgrade attention kernel + perf fixes (reduces p95 by ~20%)"

kevin: api: "api: bump to 0.15, swagger regen, preserve backwards-compatible query params"

ryan: console: "console: pin to api@0.15, update sdk examples for new streaming behavior"

maria: sdk: "sdk: publish 0.15, fix lockfile for yarn v4, update README usage example"

jamie: action items recap: @kevin merge CI fix #4130, @ryan update playbook + open api tag PR, @ellie assemble final CHANGELOG and cut console PR after api tag, @maria publish sdk and update examples. I'll kick off runtime canary at 09:00 and post updates here.

ellie: noted — I'll prepare the changelog and wait for API tag.

kevin: CI fix merged to release/runtime-0.15. runtime canary good to go from our side.

deploy-bot: runtime canary started at 09:02 UTC, canary ID c-20231106-09

jamie: started canary. monitoring p50/p95 and error rates. ping here if anything weird :eyes:

ryan: API canary ready on standby — will start at my slot once runtime promotion looks healthy.

jamie: thanks everyone — will post a quick update after runtime promote.
